pickerLine.vi: Tôi biết rất ít tiếng Anh. Khách nói chậm và dễ hiểu.
pickerLine.en: I know very little English. Clients speak slowly and simply.

beginner.speakingRules: Use very short, slow, simple sentences (about 8 words or fewer each, 1-2 sentences per reply). Use only common salon words such as nails, color, shape, price, time and today. Ask ONE question at a time. No idioms, no slang, no phrasal verbs and no long or tricky words.

pickerLine.vi: Tôi hiểu câu đơn giản. Khách nói rõ ràng, không quá nhanh.
pickerLine.en: I understand simple sentences. Clients speak clearly, not too fast.

some.speakingRules: Use simple, clear sentences that sound a little more natural than for a beginner. Common words and short everyday phrases are fine, and so are contractions. Ask at most one or two questions at a time. Avoid slang and idioms.

pickerLine.vi: Tôi trò chuyện được. Khách nói tự nhiên.
pickerLine.en: I can have a conversation. Clients speak naturally.

comfortable.speakingRules: Speak naturally, the way a real client talks at a normal pace, with everyday vocabulary. An occasional common idiom is fine. Do not simplify on purpose.

pickerLine.vi: Tôi nói tiếng Anh tốt. Khách nói nhanh, dùng tiếng lóng.
pickerLine.en: I speak English well. Clients talk fast and use slang.

fluent.speakingRules: Speak at natural, even fast, speed like a real client chatting in a salon. Use slang, idioms, casual phrasing and contractions freely. Do not simplify or slow down for the stylist.
